notes:
Topline: large DoD-focused search program, strict air-gapped requirements, procurement-heavy timeline.
- Use-case: enterprise search for classified docs + analyst support; primary workloads: embeddings for dense retrieval + reranking layer to reduce false positives.
- Scale ask: ingest ~120M documents (mix of PDFs, DOCX, scans -> OCR), expected vector store ~30TB, incremental updates daily.
- Performance targets: P95 query (retrieval + rerank) < 350ms in on-prem environment for unclassified/IL2; IL4/IL5 buckets can accept higher latency but must maintain P99 < 2s.
- Cost sensitivity: high for hosted; willing to pay for Dedicated/Private but procurement asks predictable TCO and capex-friendly licensing.
- Security: must run fully air-gapped option; signed IAA + HSM/KMS support; audit logs retained 7+ years; SSO via SAML enterprise IdP; DISA/DoD guidance referenced in security FAQ.
- POC scope agreed: 3-week non-production air-gapped POC in customer lab, evaluate indexing throughput, KV/prefix cache behavior, and reranker quality on 10k query testbench.
- Quote from CTO: "We need deterministic performance — if the reranker adds variance we can't certify workflows."
- Docs: security questionnaire submitted 2026-02-05 (drive link).
- Procurement notes: contracting officer expects a commercial item justification; legal wants explicit indemnity language for classified processing.
- Internal AE notes: push for private image delivery + remote attestation flow; highlight Redwood Optimize suggestions for batching/quantization to reduce GPU footprint.
- Key red flags: customer expects on-site SWCUS validation and source-code escrow option for long-term sustainment.
- Next MR: attach POC runbook and signed NDA, schedule discovery with infra team and DISA compliance advisor.
